rule.comment: Each IDM driver has two threads: the subscriber and the publisher thread. Both threads might be manipulating the same data, in this case the RULE__CACHE driver scope variable. To avoid cache corruption, the policy acquires a mutex before manipulating or reading the cache and releases the mutex when done. If the policy finds the mutex unavailable, that means that the same policy has been invoked by the other thread and has to finish its job, before the policy on the current thread can continue. The mutex is another driver scope vairable RULE__CACHE__MUTEX.
